'''TC-14 Big Deal''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TC-14 (GPN)|TC-14]]
* '''Published:''' 8 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Deal TC-14 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Using some new cards the Deal becomes easier to play and fun to win...

The published list has 63 cards.

== Strategy ==

The deck is based in the idea that you need force generation to deploy characters and starships. But you need also to call your opponent to deploy in CC, but knowing that you are gonna to kick is ass...That is why the clouds are there to upgrade your force drain, and because the light side has only 1 maybe 2 ships that can go to the clouds ( MF e R5 )... the importance of Vader and the saber is only to finish of because the droids have great text and hold the sites drawing 2 destinies...
